data.description:
## Context
The architecture is well documented and selected seams have strong bespoke AST negative controls, but there is no repository-wide dependency contract for stable package layers. This leaves new cross-layer imports and cycles outside the specifically protected seams detectable only by review.

## Plan
- Derive a deliberately small layer model from docs/architecture.md and current package ownership.
- Encode allowed dependency directions with an import-graph or contract checker.
- Add known-positive and known-negative fixtures so the checker cannot pass vacuously.
- Gate only stable boundaries; retain specialized Jira-family and optionality checks.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Stable package layers and permitted dependency directions are documented with rationale.
- [ ] A deterministic repository check rejects a synthetic forbidden edge and accepts a permitted edge.
- [ ] The check covers production imports without treating facade or documented lazy-import seams as accidental cycles.
- [ ] CI runs the contract check and reports actionable offending edges.
- [ ] Existing specialized boundary checks remain green and non-duplicative.
data.title: Define repository-wide package dependency contracts for stable rebar layers
